name: Groovy Palette & Frames
description: Thirty more entries on the COLORS row -- Amiga Workbench, the C64 boot screen, a Virtual Boy, rainbow, fuchsia, vaporwave -- plus eight new borders for every text box and menu. USE ADVANCED rides the engine's per-tile colorization instead of replacing it, so a palette recolours eighteen colours on screen rather than flattening them to four. A START menu browser scrolls the palettes over the running game.
